WITH rating_counts AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS rental_count
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
), rating_shares AS (
  SELECT rating, rental_count,
         rental_count / SUM(rental_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM rating_counts
), with_average AS (
  SELECT rating, rental_count, share,
         AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM rating_shares
)
SELECT SUM(rental_count) AS kept_rental_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_kept_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM with_average
WHERE share > average_share

assumptions.assumption: “Count the films rented” means count rental records attributed to each rating, so repeat rentals of the same film are counted repeatedly. Ratings with no matching rentals do not enter the average because the requested counts are derived from the qualifying rental records.
